senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; קָלַט)refuge, esp. for the unintentional man-slayer.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 2:6">Ib. 6</cite> <he>אחד שוגג … מקדימין לערי מ׳</he> both the innocent and the willful slayers go temporarily to the place of refuge; <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 160:9">Sifré Num. 160</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 2:8">Macc. II, 8</cite> <he>רוצח שגלה לעיר מִקְלָטוֹ</he> a man-slayer who arrives at his place of refuge; a. fr.
